endpoint.description: Full URL of the System One endpoint. Defaults to LM Studio's local http://localhost:1234/v1/systemone.

model.description: Model id sent with each request. Empty omits the field.

dialect.description: Wire vocabulary: systemone (yes/no type 'noul') or vercel (yes/no type 'boolean').

api_key.description: Bearer token. Optional for a local server.

api_key_env.description: Env var holding the bearer token. Defaults to JEV_API_KEY.

timeout.description: HTTP request timeout (Go duration). Defaults to 10s.
